item.title: Financial Authorities' Conservative Stance Stifles Leap in Korea's Capital Market (금융당국 보수적 태도, 한국 자본시장 도약 틀어막는다)
item.description:
Lee Yong-woo, Former Democratic Party Lawmaker (이용우 민주당 전 의원)

Our capital market is in the spotlight. The "KOSPI 10,000" level, once a distant dream just a year ago, now seems within reach. While adjustments may follow, as the adage "high mountains have deep valleys" suggests, the market's underlying strength in this upward trend is fundamentally different from before. The starting point was the amendment to Article 382-3 of the Commercial Act regarding directors' duty of loyalty. This amendment aims to prevent conglomerate controlling shareholders from pushing through reckless investments via the board without due business consideration, which could lead to the insolvency of not just the company but also its affiliates, ultimately shifting the burden onto ordinary shareholders. By passing the National Assembly plenary session in July 2025, it clarified that the purpose of corporate management is to enhance overall shareholder value, not maximize the interests of controlling shareholders, transforming the market into one where ordinary shareholders can invest with confidence. <<> The core issue of the Commercial Act amendment became centered on conflicts of interest among shareholders, triggered by the "spin-off listings" of LG Chem's and SK's secondary battery subsidiaries. The Financial Services Commission's (FSC) announcement, as part of measures to stabilize and normalize the capital market, to principally prohibit overlapping listings and allow them only under strict, exceptional criteria, stems from the same context. This points to the practice being exploited by controlling shareholders to expand their business while maintaining management control with a small equity stake, and aims to improve the asymmetrical structure where listing benefits are concentrated among a few. The FSC has established a mechanism requiring the parent company's board to assess the impact of a subsidiary's listing on shareholders and devise protective measures as a tool to fulfill the duty of loyalty. <<> Market operators and facilitators (such as the FSC, Financial Supervisory Service, and Korea Exchange) are the entities responsible for establishing market norms, i.e., "soft law," that align with this. Soft law arises from the question, "Is this legally feasible?" While not explicitly codified in law, it forms a norm through the process of assessing that feasibility. An open process where market participants and facilitators can freely ask questions and seek their meaning is a prerequisite. What facilitators must provide to participants are the criteria for market participation, and if disputes arise over these criteria, the issues must be promptly disclosed and solutions sought collaboratively. However, our reality is that when market participants encounter novel issues or matters not clearly defined in legal principles, they merely probe the feasibility through inquiries for administrative interpretation similar to authoritative legal rulings from facilitators. Can new norms truly be accumulated smoothly in an environment where facilitators and participants perceive a superior-subordinate relationship? <<> We are now in the process of creating new market norms for a market changed by the Commercial Act amendment. It is time to move beyond a rigid normative system and accumulate soft law through free discussion. For example, the FSC's policy of principally prohibiting overlapping listings is based on the overarching principle that if there is a conflict of interest among investors, overlapping listings are not permitted, and institutional arrangements must be established to resolve the conflict and obtain consent for an exception. This norm should be established by the facilitator actively gathering opinions from the company in question, its affiliates, and relevant experts. <<> A prime example of establishing such a new benchmark is the creation of the "technology special listing" pathway to facilitate capital raising for technology-driven companies, even those with losses, such as in the biotech sector. Of course, even among these biotech companies, there have been cases of management embezzlement, breach of trust, or crises arising from financial investment losses rather than technology development. In response, it would be problematic to claim that the listing standards were fundamentally flawed or the review was negligent, and thus blame the KOSPI/KOSDAQ markets or underwriters. Such a culture makes it difficult to autonomously create soft law and develop new market practices through it. If the FSC's policy of principally prohibiting overlapping listings is interpreted merely as a routine ban to avoid such controversies, it will inevitably be criticized for delaying listing reviews and hindering corporate growth. <<> Not all overlapping listings need to be banned. Some are "asymmetrical overlapping listings" that effectively pass losses only to the parent company's ordinary shareholders following a physical spin-off. Others, however, involve independent business models with separate management structures, seeking both capital raising efficiency and corporate value discovery. For instance, a listed company could venture into entirely new industries—such as high-bandwidth memory (HBM) packaging technology borrowing weaving methods from the textile industry, or DNA synthesis using inkjet printer principles—providing opportunities for investment and expansion. <<> What is needed, however, are review principles. Mechanisms should be established, such as prior explanation procedures for the parent company's ordinary shareholders, methods for soliciting minority shareholder opinions, consideration of priority allocation or alternative compensation, limits and monitoring of related-party transactions post-listing, operation of independent outside directors or special committees, and follow-up disclosure obligations for a certain period after listing. Since the nature of conflicts of interest varies case by case, it is crucial to first present minimum standards and then flexibly adjust additional safeguards on a case-by-case basis. <<> Similar issues to overlapping listings are now emerging with the listing of venture companies holding multiple voting rights. The controversy surrounding multiple voting rights among venture firms pursuing listings starkly reveals the rigid operational practices of relevant authorities. Citing the burden of handling their first-ever review of a company with multiple voting rights, the reviewing authorities have been demanding that such companies eliminate these rights. <<> During discussions in the 21st National Assembly on introducing multiple voting rights for venture companies, there were calls for necessary safeguards: if multiple voting rights are granted, they must be clearly disclosed, and the conditions for their dissolution should be stipulated in the articles of incorporation, allowing the market to properly price them. While multiple voting rights violate the one-share-one-vote principle and risk infringing on the rights of ordinary shareholders, they are necessary for innovative technology companies to vest responsibility in founders when their equity stakes have been significantly diluted through multiple rounds of capital raising. Market Kurly is a prime example. During its growth, Market Kurly continuously attracted external capital, diluting the founder's stake to just 5-6%. If financial investors pursue an exit after listing, the governance structure could become extremely unstable. This structure could undermine the founder's management philosophy or lead to a focus on short-term profits, harming ordinary shareholders. In such situations, multiple voting rights are necessary. However, instead of supporting Market Kurly to design creative shareholder protection measures considering its unique circumstances, the reviewing authorities treated the low equity stake itself as a disqualifying factor and consistently delayed the review process. <<> For the development of Korea's capital market, a change in attitude from regulatory bodies and market facilitators must precede any legal overhaul. Simply banning overlapping listings and shying away from multiple voting rights will not resolve the "Korea Discount." <<> First, relevant authorities must proactively act as mediators for conflicts of interest. They should pre-emptively identify potential conflict points, publicize them, and clearly provide "minimum guidelines" for the protective measures companies must present. This would enhance the predictability of listings for companies and open pathways for capital raising. <<> Second, there must be a paradigm shift toward "disclosure-centered regulation." Given the expanded duty of loyalty for directors, companies should be required to transparently disclose the basis for board decisions and shareholder protection efforts, allowing the market to evaluate them. If problems arise, letting the market reflect them in prices or filtering them through shareholder meetings aligns with capitalist principles. <<> Third, internal innovation is needed to overcome a "practical risk-aversion" culture. The practice of delaying reviews to avoid responsibility for new systems or unprecedented cases erodes the capital market's competitiveness. Review systems should be built with specialized personnel and the flexibility to handle innovative governance models. <<> Fourth, a market culture that does not fear legal disputes must be fostered. Based on the strengthened duty of loyalty, shareholders should actively exercise their rights, allowing legal precedents formed through this process to become market norms. Rather than the reviewing authorities trying to administratively adjudicate everything, order should be established through autonomous coordination among market participants and strengthened legal accountability. <<> For the Republic of Korea's capital market to take its next leap, there is an urgent need for market participants to create new precedents regarding conflicts of interest and proactively adapt to the changing legal and economic environment. It is time for the relevant authorities to ask themselves whether they are acting as a catalyst to foster market growth, rather than just wielding the sword of regulation. ( 우리 자본시장이 주목받고 있다. 불과 1년 전만 해도 꿈도 꾸기 힘들었던 ‘코스피 1만’도 머지 않아 보인다. 산이 높으면 골도 깊다는 격언에 따라 조정이 따를 수도 있지만, 증세의 기초 체력 면에서 이전과는 전혀 다른 모습이다. 그 출발점은 상법 제382조의 3 ‘이사충실의무’의 개정이었다. 재벌기업 지배주주의 의사에 따라 이사회가 사업을 고려하지 않은 채 무리한 투자를 진행함에 따라 그 회사뿐만 아니라 관계회사의 부실로 이어져 일반주주의 책임으로 이어지는 것을 차단하기 위한 것이다. 2025년 7월 국회 본회의 통과로 기업 경영의 목적이 지배주주의 이익 극대화가 아닌 전체 주주가치 제고에 있음을 명확히 한 것으로 일반주주가 믿고 투자할 수 있는 시장으로 바뀐 것이다.)

item.title: Chung-Ang University's Department of Theater Arts Wins Best Work Award and Outstanding Acting Awards at Asian Theatre Schools Festival (중앙대학교 연극학과, 아시아 연극대학 페스티벌에서 최우수 작품상·우수 연기상 수상)
item.description:
Chung-Ang University (President Park Se-hyun) announced on the 1st that its Department of Theater Arts won the Best Work Award and two Outstanding Acting Awards at the 8th Asian Theatre Schools Festival. (중앙대학교(총장 박세현) 연극학과는 1일 ‘제8회 아시아 연극대학 페스티벌(The 8th Asian Theatre Schools Festival)’에서 최우수 작품상과 2개의 우수 연기상을 수상했다고 밝혔다.)

Hosted by the Asian Theatre Education Centre (ATEC) and organized by The Central Academy of Drama in Beijing, China, the Department of Theater Arts' production of <Candida> was honored with the Best Work Award. Additionally, student Kim Na-hyeon, who played the role of Candida, and student Im Gyeol, who performed as Morell, each received Outstanding Acting Awards. (아시아연극교육센터(ATEC)가 주최하고 중국 북경 중앙희극학원(The Central Academy of Drama)이 주관한 이번 축제에서, 중앙대 연극학과의 작품 <캔디다>가 최우수 작품상으로 선정되는 영예를 안았다. 이와 함께 캔디다 역을 맡은 김나현 학생과 몰렐 역을 연기한 임결 학생이 각각 우수 연기상을 받았다.)

Jung Da-eun, a student from the Department of Theater Arts who directed the play, shared her directorial intent, saying, "We prepared a stage that carefully excavates the hidden secrets within the gaps of others' realms that we could never have known. Through this work, I wanted to trace the answers to questions like what true companionship is, what love is, and what existence itself means, together with the audience." (연출을 맡은 연극학과 정다은 학생은 “우리가 결코 알 수 없었던 타인의 영역, 그 틈새에 숨겨진 비밀을 조심스럽게 파헤쳐보는 무대를 준비했다”며, “이번 작품을 통해 진정한 동반자란 무엇인가, 사랑이란 무엇인가, 그리고 나라는 존재는 무엇인가라는 질문의 답을 관객과 함께 추적하고 싶었다”고 연출 의도를 전했다.)

Professor Choi Jae-oh of the Department of Theater Arts, who serves as Vice Chair of the Asian Theatre Education Centre (ATEC), stated, "At this year's festival, held in celebration of the 170th anniversary of playwright George Bernard Shaw's birth, the students' <Candida>—which filled a clean, empty stage with just a single desk and a few chairs through beautiful and delicate acting—received a great response." (아시아연극교육센터(ATEC) 부이사장인 최재오 연극학과 교수는 “극작가 조지 버나드 쇼의 탄생 170주년을 기념하며 열린 올해 페스티벌에서, 책상 하나와 몇 개의 의자만 사용한 깔끔한 빈 무대를 아름답고 섬세한 연기로 채운 학생들의 <캔디다>가 큰 호응을 받았다”고 밝혔다.)

The Asian Theatre Education Centre (ATEC), which organized this festival, consists of 19 member schools from 12 countries worldwide, including South Korea, the United States, China, Japan, and Singapore, and leads global theatre education through continuous exchanges. (이번 페스티벌을 주최한 아시아연극교육센터(ATEC)은 한국, 미국, 중국, 일본, 싱가포르 등 세계 12개국 19개교가 가입해 지속적으로 교류하며 세계 연극 교육을 이끌고 있다.)

item.title: Soongsil University Launches G-LAMP Project Group, Accelerating Innovation in Basic Science Research (숭실대, G-LAMP사업단 개소… 기초과학 연구 혁신 본격화)
item.description:
Soongsil University (President Yoon Jae Lee) announced that its G-LAMP Project Group held the "Soongsil University G-LAMP Project Group Launch Ceremony" on May 28 at the university's Hyeongnam Hall, marking the official start of efforts to innovate basic science research and cultivate future convergent talents. (숭실대학교(총장 이윤재) G-LAMP사업단은 5월 28일 숭실대 형남홀에서 ‘숭실대학교 G-LAMP사업단 개소식’을 열고 기초과학 연구 혁신과 미래 융합인재 양성을 위한 공식 출범을 알렸다고 밝혔다.)

Approximately 100 people attended the event, including officials from the Ministry of Education, Yoo Jae-joon, President of the National Association of College of Natural Sciences Deans, officials from G-LAMP Project Groups at other universities, the president of Soongsil University and key administrators, participating faculty and researchers, and graduate students. The ceremony featured a welcome speech by the president of Soongsil University, an encouraging address by Yoo Jae-joon, President of the National Association of College of Natural Sciences Deans, and a congratulatory speech by Chae Hong-joon, Director of the Ministry of Education. (이날 행사에는 교육부 관계자를 비롯해 유재준 전국자연과학대학장협의회장, 타 대학 G-LAMP사업단 관계자, 숭실대 총장 및 주요 보직자, 참여 교수진과 연구원, 대학원생 등 100여 명이 참석했다. 행사에서는 숭실대 총장 환영사와 유재준 전국자연과학대학장협의회장 격려사, 채홍준 교육부 과장 축사 등이 이어졌다.)

The G-LAMP (Global Leading University for Basic Sciences and Interdisciplinary Research) project is a university basic research support program funded by the Ministry of Education and the National Research Foundation of Korea. It aims to strengthen universities' basic science research capabilities and foster a world-class research ecosystem. (G-LAMP사업은 교육부와 한국연구재단이 지원하는 대학 기초연구 지원사업이다. 대학의 기초과학 연구역량을 강화하고 세계 수준의 연구 생태계를 조성하는 것을 목표로 한다.)

The G-LAMP Project Group at Soongsil University plans to build a creative research environment centered on AI, bio, and data-based convergent research, and focus on nurturing the next generation of research talent. It will also expand industry-academia-research cooperation networks and promote joint research and academic exchanges to strengthen basic science research capabilities and cultivate future convergent talents. (숭실대 G-LAMP사업단은 AI·바이오·데이터 기반 융합연구를 중심으로 창의적인 연구 환경을 구축하고 차세대 연구인재 양성에 힘쓸 계획이다. 또 기초과학 분야 연구역량 강화와 미래 융합인재 양성을 위해 산·학·연 협력 네트워크를 확대하고 공동연구 및 학술 교류 활성화에도 나설 예정이다.)

In particular, the project group will pursue the expansion of global joint research, the establishment of international cooperation networks, the enhancement of undergraduate and graduate student research capabilities, and the creation of advanced research infrastructure. It also plans to operate high school-linked basic science education and mentoring programs to build a research and education platform connected with the local community. (특히 사업단은 글로벌 공동연구 확대와 국제 협력 네트워크 구축, 학부생·대학원생 연구역량 강화, 첨단 연구 인프라 조성 등을 추진한다. 또한 고교 연계 기초과학 교육 및 멘토링 프로그램을 운영해 지역사회와 연계한 연구·교육 플랫폼도 구축해 나갈 방침이다.)

Kang Wi-kyung, Head of the Soongsil University G-LAMP Project Group, stated, "With this launch ceremony as a catalyst, we will further expand convergence research based on basic sciences and global cooperation," adding, "We will do our utmost to cultivate outstanding research talents who will lead future science and technology." (강위경 숭실대 G-LAMP사업단장은 “이번 개소식을 계기로 기초과학 기반 융합연구와 글로벌 협력을 더욱 확대하겠다”며 “미래 과학기술을 이끌 우수 연구인재 양성에 최선을 다하겠다”고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, the Soongsil University G-LAMP Project Group plans to expand its cooperation network with domestic and international research institutions, operate various academic and educational programs, and accelerate efforts to strengthen research competitiveness. (한편 숭실대 G-LAMP사업단은 앞으로 국내외 연구기관과 협력 네트워크를 넓히고 다양한 학술·교육 프로그램을 운영하며 연구 경쟁력 강화에 속도를 낼 계획이다.)

item.title: National Future Strategy Institute: "Carbon Neutrality Must Shift from Environmental Policy to National Competitiveness Strategy" (국가미래전략원 “탄소중립, 환경정책에서 국가경쟁력 전략으로 전환”)
item.description:
A proposal has emerged to move South Korea's carbon neutrality discussions beyond emission reduction targets or the expansion of renewable energy, integrating electricity, hydrogen, steel, artificial intelligence, data, and balanced regional development into a single industrial ecosystem strategy and redesigning it as a "national competitiveness strategy." (우리나라 탄소중립 논의를 감축 목표 설정이나 재생에너지 확대 중심에서 벗어나, 전력·수소·철강·인공지능·데이터·지역균형발전을 하나의 산업 생태계 전략으로 통합해 ‘국가 경쟁력 전략’으로 재설계 해야 한다는 제안이 나온다.)

On the 1st, the Seoul National University National Future Strategy Institute (Director Kang Won-taek) published a national policy proposal report titled "Industrial and Security Strategy of Carbon Neutrality and Korea's Green Transition (K-GX)," which argues that the implementation strategy for the Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) should shift from being goal-oriented to an execution-focused industrial transformation. The proposal suggests that carbon neutrality should go beyond a simple "environmental policy" centered on greenhouse gas reduction targets, being redesigned as a national competitiveness strategy that integrates industrial competitiveness, energy security, and the transformation of advanced manufacturing combined with artificial intelligence (AI). (1일 서울대 국가미래전략원(원장 강원택)이 내놓은 국가정책 제안 보고서인 ‘탄소중립의 산업·안보 전략화와 한국형 녹색전환(K-GX)’은 국가온실가스 감축 목표(NDC) 이행 전략을 목표 중심에서 실행 중심의 산업전환으로 바꿔야 한다고 주장한다. 탄소중립은 단순히 온실가스 감축 목표 중심의 탄소중립 ‘환경정책’을 넘어, 산업 경쟁력과 에너지 안보, 인공지능(AI)이 결합된 첨단 제조업 전환을 통합한 국가 경쟁력 전략으로 재설계돼야 한다는 제안이다.)

According to this report, jointly researched and authored by academics including Seoul National University Professor Yun Je-yong (Department of Chemical and Biological Engineering), major countries are maintaining their greenhouse gas reduction targets while simultaneously protecting their domestic industries, strategically utilizing fossil fuels, and securing critical supply chains. The report states, "Climate policy is transforming into a national strategic instrument combined with industrial competitiveness, energy security, and technological leadership," and proposes, "Beyond subsidy-centered industrial policy, an integrated industrial ecosystem design that fuses electricity, hydrogen, and artificial intelligence is required." (윤제용 서울대 교수(화학생물공학부) 등 학계 연구자들이 공동 연구·작성한 이 보고서를 보면, 주요국들은 온실가스 감축 목표를 유지하면서도 자국 산업 보호, 전략적인 화석연료 활용, 핵심 공급망 확보를 병행하고 있다. 보고서는 “기후정책은 산업 경쟁력·에너지 안보·기술 주도권과 결합된 국가 전략 수단으로 전환되고 있다”며 “보조금 중심 산업정책을 넘어, 전력·수소·인공지능을 융합하는 통합적 산업 생태계 설계가 요구된다”고 제안했다.)

The report suggests that if the 2035 national greenhouse gas reduction target is the agenda, then Korea's Green Transition is a framework to convert this into an industrial growth strategy that also considers economic benefits. It proposes, "Responses to the climate crisis should be approached not as a cost burden, but as an opportunity to secure low-carbon manufacturing competitiveness and create new markets." To achieve this, it argues that the structure of Korea's Green Transition should consist of three main pillars: △ Energy Transition (carbon-free electricity supply and preemptive grid construction) △ Industrial Transition (process innovation in hard-to-abate industries and creation of new markets) △ System Transition (integrated design of infrastructure based on electricity, hydrogen, artificial intelligence, and data). (보고서는 2035년 국가 온실가스 감축 목표가 의제라면, 한국형 녹색전환은 이를 경제적 실리까지 고려하는 산업 성장전략으로 전환하는 프레임이라며, “기후위기 대응을 비용 부담이 아니라 저탄소 제조 경쟁력 확보와 신시장 창출의 기회로 접근해야 한다”고 제안했다. 또 이를 위해 한국형 녹색전환 구조를 △에너지 전환(무탄소 전력 공급 및 전력망 선제 구축) △산업 전환(감축이 어려운 산업의 공정 혁신 및 신시장 창출) △시스템 전환(전력·수소·인공지능·데이터 기반 인프라의 통합 설계) 등 3대 축으로 구성해야 한다고 주장한다.)

As an agenda to implement these three pillars, the report presents '5+1 Priority Tasks'. The five priority tasks are: △ Competitive transformation to carbon-free electricity △ Accelerating decarbonization of major manufacturing industries, centered on steel △ Building a phased hydrogen supply portfolio △ Balanced regional development and GX (Green Transformation) transition △ Establishing a market ecosystem that attracts voluntary inflow of private capital. Furthermore, it proposes the need to integrate an AI and data-based policy transformation as a cross-cutting execution foundation for these five tasks. (이런 3대 축을 실행할 의제로는 ‘5+1 우선과제’를 제시했다. △경쟁력 있는 무탄소 전력 대전환 △철강 중심으로 주력 제조업의 탈탄소 전환 가속화 △단계별 수소 공급 포트폴리오 구축 △지역 균형 발전과 GX 전환 △민간자본이 자발적으로 유입되는 시장 생태계 구축이 5대 우선 과제라는 것이다. 나아가, 5대 과제를 횡단하는 실행 기반으로 인공지능·데이터 기반 정책 전환이 결합될 필요가 있다고 제안했다.)

The National Future Strategy Institute stated, "South Korea's implementation strategy for its national greenhouse gas reduction targets has been pursued by first setting reduction goals and then supplementing the means later. However, to enhance execution capability, the design approach must be switched to pre-reflect the timing, cost structure, and industrial ripple effects of introducing carbon dioxide reduction technologies." It added, "Korea's Green Transition must be redefined as a national competitiveness strategy that restructures the country's energy and industrial framework." (국가미래전략원은 “우리나라 국가온실가스 감축목표 이행 전략이 그동안 감축 목표를 먼저 설정하고 그 수단은 나중에 보완하는 방식으로 추진됐으나, 실행력을 높이려면 이산화탄소 감축 기술을 도입하는 시기와 비용 구조, 산업 파급효과를 사전에 반영하는 설계 방식으로 전환해야 한다”며, “한국형 녹색전환은 우리나라 에너지·산업 구조를 재편하는 국가 경쟁력 전략으로 재정의돼야 한다”고 밝혔다.)

Senior Reporter Jo Kye-wan kyewan@hani.co.kr (조계완 선임기자 kyewan@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Seoul National University of Science and Technology's Early Employment Contract Department Hosts Special Lecture by Professor Jeong Jae-seung (서울시립대 조기취업형 계약학과, 정재승 교수 초청 특별강연 성료)
item.description:
The Early Employment Contract Department project team at Seoul National University of Science and Technology (President Won Yong-geol) held a department information session and special lecture on May 29 for prospective freshmen and current students. (서울시립대학교(총장 원용걸) 조기취업형 계약학과 사업단은 5월 29일 예비 신입생, 재학생 등을 대상으로 학과설명회 및 특별강연을 개최했다.)

This event was designed to introduce the curriculum and achievements of the Early Employment Contract Department and to provide opportunities for science and engineering talents, who will lead future industries, to explore career paths and prepare for the future. (이번 행사는 조기취업형 계약학과의 교육과정과 성과를 소개하고, 미래 산업을 이끌어갈 이공계 인재들에게 진로 탐색과 미래 준비의 기회를 제공하기 위해 마련되었다.)

In the first part, the department information session introduced the graduate school's Biohealth and Eco-Convergence Department curriculum, industry-academia research projects, corporate-linked education operation systems, and student support programs. In particular, it drew attention by sharing cases of curriculum operation reflecting industrial field demands and the cultivation of practical master's-level talent through joint corporate-university research. (1부 학과설명회에서는 대학원 바이오헬스‧에코융합학과의 교육과정, 산학협력 기반 연구 프로젝트, 기업 연계 교육 운영 체계, 학생 지원제도 등을 소개하였다. 특히 산업 현장의 수요를 반영한 교육과정 운영과 기업·대학 공동연구를 통한 실무형 석사급 인재 양성 사례를 공유하며 참석자들의 관심을 모았다.)

In the second part, Professor Jeong Jae-seung, a leading domestic neuroscientist, gave a special lecture titled "Reflecting on the Future of Science and Engineering through Neuroscience in the Age of Artificial Intelligence." (이어 2부에서는 국내 대표 뇌과학자인 정재승 교수가 「인공지능시대, 뇌과학으로 이공계의 미래를 성찰하다」를 주제로 특별강연을 진행하였다.)

Professor Jeong explained the impact of the development of artificial intelligence technology on industry and society, emphasizing the importance of creativity, convergent thinking, and problem-solving capabilities that future science and engineering talents should possess. He also highlighted the unique thinking abilities and learning capacities inherent to humans from a neuroscience perspective, explaining that human-centered insight and the ability to ask questions will become key to future competitiveness amid technological advancements. (정 교수는 인공지능 기술의 발전이 산업과 사회에 미치는 영향을 설명하며, 미래 이공계 인재가 갖추어야 할 창의성, 융합적 사고, 문제해결 역량의 중요성을 강조했다. 또한 뇌과학적 관점에서 인간만이 가진 고유한 사고 능력과 학습 역량을 조명하며, 기술 발전 속에서도 인간 중심의 통찰과 질문하는 능력이 미래 경쟁력의 핵심이 될 것이라고 설명했다.)

During the Q&A session following the lecture, students raised various questions about career choices, job changes in the age of artificial intelligence, and the ideal future talent profile. Participants gained new perspectives and insights into the future society through this meaningful time. (강연 후 진행된 질의응답 시간에는 진로 선택, 인공지능 시대의 직업 변화, 미래 인재상 등에 대한 학생들의 다양한 질문이 이어졌으며, 참석자들은 미래 사회를 바라보는 새로운 시각과 통찰을 얻는 뜻깊은 시간을 가졌다.)

The Early Employment Contract Department at Seoul National University of Science and Technology operates as an industry-education integrated model where students are hired by partner companies upon admission, combining academic study with practical work. It has achieved high employment rates and corporate satisfaction by cultivating practical talent demanded by the industrial field. (서울시립대학교 조기취업형 계약학과는 학생이 입학과 동시에 참여기업에 채용되어 학업과 실무를 병행하는 산학일체형 교육모델로 운영되고 있으며, 산업 현장에서 요구하는 실무형 인재 양성을 통해 높은 취업률과 기업 만족도를 달성하고 있다.)

Jeong Yeon-du, head of the Early Employment Contract Department project team, said, "Through this event, prospective freshmen have gained a better understanding of the Early Employment Contract Department and insights into future industrial changes," adding, "We will continue to focus on nurturing key talent that will lead future industries through excellent educational programs and diverse industry-academia collaboration activities." (정연두 조기취업형 계약학과 사업단장은 “이번 행사를 통해 예비 신입생들이 조기취업형 계약학과에 대한 이해를 높이고, 미래 산업 변화에 대한 통찰을 얻는 계기가 되었다”며 “앞으로도 우수한 교육 프로그램과 다양한 산학협력 활동을 통해 미래 산업을 선도할 핵심 인재 양성에 힘쓰겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Currently, the Early Employment Contract Department at Seoul National University of Science and Technology operates the Biohealth and Eco-Convergence Department. Based on the recruitment-linked selection of all participating students and high employment outcomes, it has established itself as a core talent cultivation model for Seoul's strategic industrial sectors. (서울시립대학교 조기취업형 계약학과는 현재 바이오헬스‧에코융합학과를 운영하고 있으며, 참여학생 전원 채용연계 선발 및 높은 취업성과를 바탕으로 서울시 전략산업 분야의 핵심 인재 양성 모델로 자리매김하고 있다.)

item.title: K-Chips Act Mimics US Chips Act but Misses Upside Sharing... Aftermath Looms Three Years Later (미 칩스법 흉내만 낸 K-칩스법…초과이익 공유, 3년 뒤 후폭풍으로)
item.description:
As controversy continues over how semiconductor giants—currently enjoying a boom—should use their astronomical profits, criticism is emerging that a mistake made three years ago has now come back as a boomerang: when the special law to heavily support semiconductor companies was introduced, it failed to include an "upside sharing" provision like that in the U.S. legislation. (초호황을 맞은 반도체 대기업의 천문학적 이익 사용 방안을 둘러싸고 논란이 계속되자 3년 전 반도체기업을 대폭 지원하는 특별법 도입 당시 미국처럼 ‘초과이익 공유’(upside sharing) 규정을 도입하지 않은 실책이 뒤늦게 부메랑으로 돌아왔다는 지적이 나온다.)

The U.S. CHIPS Act, enacted in August 2022 to strengthen the domestic semiconductor supply chain base, provided a basis for direct subsidies to corporate investments while also stipulating a mechanism to recoup profits to protect taxpayers. The following February, detailed subsidy guidelines were finalized, requiring semiconductor companies receiving direct subsidies of $150 million (about 226 billion won) or more to share up to 75% of the subsidy with the U.S. government if they generate "windfall excess profits" significantly surpassing initial projections. At the time, the U.S. Department of Commerce emphasized this as "part of a commitment to protect taxpayer money." (미국이 자국 내 반도체 공급망 기반을 강화하기 위해 2022년 8월 제정한 ‘칩스법’은 기업의 투자에 직접 보조금을 줄 수 있는 근거를 두면서도, 납세자 보호를 위한 이익 환수 근거를 명시했다. 이듬해 2월엔 보조금 세부 지침을 확정하면서 1억5천만달러(2260억원가량) 이상의 직접 보조금을 받는 반도체 기업이 당초 제출한 예상치를 크게 상회하는 ‘횡재성 초과이익’을 낼 경우, 보조금의 최대 75%를 미국 정부와 공유하도록 의무화했다. 당시 미국 상무부는 이를 “납세자의 돈을 보호하겠다는 약속의 일환”이라고 강조했다.)

In South Korea, the "K-Chips Act" (including the Restriction of Special Taxation Act) passed the National Assembly plenary session on March 30, 2023, referencing the U.S. CHIPS Act, but it differed from the American legislation. It only emulated the corporate support aspect, without including an upside-sharing rule. According to the minutes of the full session of the National Assembly's Strategy and Finance Committee held on March 22 of the same year, opposition lawmakers from the Democratic Party of Korea mentioned the risks of unilateral tax cuts and preferential support, urging the government to establish a profit recoupment mechanism. At the time, Rep. Shin Dong-geun pointed out, "In the U.S., profits are recouped. We should not only provide unilateral support but also create a basis and measures for companies to contribute to the domestic economy during boom periods." Rep. Yang Kyung-sook also said, "We need to prepare concrete social return measures, such as introducing a windfall tax on excess profits when companies earn a lot." (칩스법을 참고해 국내에서도 2023년 3월30일 ‘케이(K)칩스법’(조세특례제한법 등)이 국회 본회의를 통과했지만, 미국의 법안과는 달랐다. 기업 지원만 본떴을 뿐 초과이익 공유 규정은 담기지 않은 것이다. 같은 달 22일 국회 기획재정위원회 전체회의 회의록을 보면, 야당이었던 더불어민주당 의원들은 일방적인 감세와 특혜 지원의 위험성을 언급하며 정부에 이익 환수 장치 마련을 촉구했다. 당시 신동근 의원은 “미국에서는 수익을 환수하게 돼 있다. 우리도 일방적 지원만 할 것이 아니라 호황기에 국내 경제에 기여할 수 있는 근거와 대책을 만들어야 한다”고 지적했다. 양경숙 의원도 “돈을 많이 벌었을 때 초과 이득에 대한 횡재세 도입 등 구체적인 사회 환원 방안을 마련해야 한다”고 말했다.)

However, then-Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy and Finance Choo Kyung-ho drew a line, stating, "It is customary for companies to generate profits, create jobs, and then pay taxes afterward. It is not appropriate for authorities to comment on how specific companies handle their profits." He added, "There are also many experts who express concerns about the U.S. profit recoupment provisions." In the end, the K-Chips Act passed the plenary session, significantly expanding the tax credit rate for facility investments in semiconductors and other advanced industries (from 8% to 15% for large companies). Even during the law revision in February of last year, the tax credit rate for large companies was raised to 20%, further expanding benefits. (그러나 당시 추경호 부총리 겸 기획재정부 장관은 “기업이 수익을 창출하고 일자리를 만든 뒤 사후적으로 세금을 내는 것이 일반 상례”라며 “특정 기업의 수익 처리에 관해 당국자가 뭐라고 하는 것은 적절치 않다”고 선을 그었다. 이어 “미국의 이익 환수 규정에 대해 전문가들이 우려하는 목소리도 많다”고 덧붙였다. 결국 케이칩스법안은 반도체 등 첨단산업에 설비투자 세액공제 비율(대기업 기준)을 8%→15%로 대폭 확대하는 내용으로 본회의에서 통과됐다. 지난해 2월 법 개정 때에도 대기업 세액공제율을 20%까지 상향하는 등 혜택이 확대됐다.)

Professor Lee Chang-min of Hanyang University (Business Administration) said, "Since taxpayer money is used to support some companies, an institutional framework for society to share the fruits should have been established even when the law was enacted. I believe it is still possible to discuss revising the law now." (이창민 한양대 교수(경영학)는 “세금으로 일부 기업을 지원하는 만큼 법 제정 당시에도 결실을 사회가 함께 나눌 수 있는 제도적 틀을 마련했어야 했다”며 “지금이라도 법 개정 논의를 할 수 있다고 본다”고 말했다.)

By Park Su-ji, Reporter suji@hani.co.kr (박수지 기자 suji@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Semiconductor Super Boom Driving Bull Markets in Major Countries…Time to Focus on the 'Trickle-Down Effect' (주요국 상승장 이끄는 반도체 슈퍼 호황…‘낙수효과’에 주목할 때)
item.description:
SK Hynix, on the verge of joining the trillion-dollar market cap club, is poised to challenge Samsung Electronics' long-held position as the top company by market capitalization in South Korea. As of May 28, Samsung Electronics' market cap (excluding preferred shares) stood at approximately 1,749 trillion won, while SK Hynix's market cap was 1,616 trillion won, narrowing the gap to about 93% of Samsung's level. Just a year ago, on May 1 last year, just before the domestic stock market rally began in earnest, SK Hynix's market cap relative to Samsung's was only about 39%. In roughly one year, the gap between the top two companies by market cap in South Korea has shrunk to a narrow margin. During the same period, SK Hynix's stock price surged 1,190%, while Samsung Electronics' stock price rose only 440%. (에스케이(SK)하이닉스가 시가총액 1조달러 클럽 가입과 함께 삼성전자가 굳건히 지키고 있는 국내 시가총액 1위까지 넘볼 태세다. 5월28일 기준 삼성전자(우선주 제외)의 시가총액은 약 1749조원이며 에스케이하이닉스의 시가총액은 1616조원으로, 에스케이하이닉스 시가총액은 삼성전자의 93% 수준까지 바짝 다가섰다. 국내 주식시장의 랠리가 본격화되기 직전인 지난해 5월1일 삼성전자 대비 에스케이하이닉스 시가총액 비율은 약 39% 수준에 불과했다. 약 1년 만에 국내 시가총액 1, 2위 기업간 격차가 근소한 수준까지 좁혀진 것이다. 동기간 에스케이하이닉스 주가는 1190% 상승한 반면에 삼성전자 주가는 440% 상승한 데 그친 영향이다.)

The reduction in the market cap gap between the two companies representing South Korea's semiconductor industry can primarily be attributed to SK Hynix's early lead in high-bandwidth memory (HBM) semiconductors. Additionally, while Samsung Electronics has a diverse business portfolio, SK Hynix is solely focused on semiconductors. Given the high expectations for a sustained semiconductor super cycle, intense competition between Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix for the top market cap spot is likely to unfold going forward. (국내 반도체산업을 대변하는 양대 기업의 시가총액 격차가 축소된 원인에는 에스케이하이닉스가 고대역폭 메모리 반도체(HBM)를 선점한 효과를 우선 들 수 있다. 또한, 삼성전자는 다양한 사업 포트폴리오를 가지고 있는 반면에 에스케이하이닉스는 반도체에만 집중한 영향으로 해석된다. 반도체 슈퍼 사이클이 지속될 기대감이 크다는 점에서 시가총액 1등 자리를 두고 삼성전자와 에스케이하이닉스의 뜨거운 경쟁이 앞으로 펼쳐질 가능성이 크다.)

As the saying goes, there is no eternal winner, and the fact that South Korea's leading semiconductor companies can engage in healthy competition is a positive signal for the domestic stock market and economy. Of course, concerns about severe polarization in the stock market, driven by the sharp rise in these semiconductor bellwether stocks and the resulting concentration, along with bubble risks, are being raised. However, considering that the semiconductor concentration is thoroughly based on profit cycles, it appears to be a somewhat different phenomenon from so-called bubble risks. (영원한 승자는 없다는 말처럼 국내 대표 반도체 업체들이 선의의 경쟁을 벌일 수 있음은 국내 주식시장과 경제에는 긍정적 신호다. 물론 이들 반도체 대장주 주가 급등과 이에 따른 쏠림 현상으로 주식시장 내 심각한 양극화 현상을 우려하는 목소리와 함께 버블 리스크도 제기되고 있다. 그러나 반도체 쏠림 현상이 철저히 이익 사이클에 기반하고 있음을 고려할 때 소위 버블 리스크와 다소 다른 결이라는 판단이다.)

Above all, the semiconductor concentration is not a unique phenomenon limited to South Korea; it is simultaneously occurring in major countries such as the United States. This is an unprecedented outcome of a strong artificial intelligence (AI) investment cycle and the expansive nature of the AI industry. Looking at global stock markets this year, the U.S., South Korea, Taiwan, and Japan—countries with solid foundations in AI and semiconductor industries—are continuing a strong rally compared to other major markets. It's time to capitalize on the AI and semiconductor super cycle. (무엇보다 반도체 쏠림 현상이 국내만의 독특한 현상은 아니고 미국 등 주요국에서 동시에 나타나고 있다. 강력한 인공지능(AI) 투자 사이클과 인공지능 산업 확장성이 낳은 이례적 현상이다. 올해 전세계 주식시장을 보면 인공지능 및 반도체산업 기반이 단단한 미국, 한국, 대만 및 일본 주식시장이 여타 주요국 주식시장 대비 강한 상승랠리를 이어가고 있다. 인공지능 및 반도체 슈퍼 사이클을 즐겨야 할 시기다.)

The key factor is the impact or trickle-down effect of the semiconductor industry's performance on the stock market and the broader economy. The Bank of Korea, in its May revised economic outlook, raised its growth forecasts for this year and next to 2.6% (from 2.0%) and 2.1% (from 1.8%), respectively. The current account surplus for this year was revised upward to $250 billion, more than double the 2024 figure ($123.1 billion). Notably, the Bank of Korea projected that GDP growth could be further revised up if the semiconductor boom persists. (중요한 것은 반도체 업황이 주식시장은 물론 경기에 미칠 영향 혹은 낙수효과다. 한국은행은 5월 수정 경제전망을 통해 올해와 내년 성장률을 각각 2.6%(기존 2.0%), 2.1%(기존 1.8%)로 상향 조정했다. 올해 경상수지 흑자 규모는 2500억달러로 2024년(1231억달러) 대비 두 배 이상 상향 조정했다. 특히 한국은행은 반도체 경기 호황 지속 시 국내총생산 성장률이 추가 상향될 것으로 전망했다.)

Although it may cause some side effects like concentration or polarization, the strong semiconductor industry performance has an absolute impact on South Korea's economic expansion cycle and will continue to play a crucial role in supporting the domestic economy. It is time to pay attention to where the benefits of the semiconductor super boom, or the trickle-down effect, will primarily flow. (쏠림 현상 혹은 양극화라는 일부 부작용을 유발시킬 수 있지만 반도체 업황 호조는 국내 경기 확장사이클에 절대적 영향을 미치고 있고 앞으로도 국내 경기를 지지하는 중요한 역할을 할 것이다. 반도체 슈퍼 호황의 수혜, 즉 낙수효과가 주로 어디로 흘러갈지를 주목해야 할 시점이다.)

Park Sang-hyun, Senior Expert at iM Securities (박상현 iM증권 수석 전문위원)

item.title: ‘A Foreseen Gambling Den’, Indeed…Day Traders Swarm Samsung and SK Hynix Leverage ETFs (‘예견된 투전판’, 역시…단타족 들끓는 삼전닉스 레버리지)
item.description:
As the KOSPI surged in a short period, investors’ ‘day trading’ patterns have intensified, leading to extreme volatility due to short-term overheating. Adding fuel to the fire are the Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs) launched on the 27th. Financial authorities are closely monitoring the situation and considering further responses. (코스피가 단기간에 급등하는 과정에서 투자자들의 ‘단타 거래’ 양상이 심해지면서 단기 과열로 인한 극심한 변동성을 겪고 있다. 여기에 불을 붙인 것은 지난 27일부터 출시된 삼성전자·에스케이(SK)하이닉스 레버리지 상장지수펀드(ETF)다. 금융당국은 상황을 예의주시하며 추가 대응을 고려 중이다.)

Looking at the top 20 stocks by daily turnover ratio (trading volume relative to listed stocks) on the KOSPI from the 27th to the 29th, the first week of the launch of 16 single-stock leveraged ETFs for Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, the highest turnover ratio was recorded by ‘SOL SK Hynix Futures Single Stock Inverse 2X’ at a whopping 2,014.31% (as of May 28). This means that all listed shares changed hands over 20 times in a single day. Nearly all 15 to 16 single-stock leveraged ETFs ranked within the top group for all three days, with many products showing turnover ratios of 100–200%. For comparison, the daily turnover ratios of Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix as of the 1st were 0.77% and 0.79%, respectively, highlighting the extreme day-trading pattern. (삼성전자와 에스케이하이닉스 단일종목 레버리지 상장지수펀드 16종이 출시된 첫주인 지난 27∼29일 유가증권시장 일일 회전율(상장종목 대비 거래량의 비율) 상위 20개 종목을 살펴보니, 가장 높은 회전율을 나타낸 것은 ‘솔(SOL) 에스케이하이닉스선물단일종목인버스2X’로 무려 2014.31%(5월28일)에 달했다. 상장된 주식 전체가 하루 동안 20번 넘도록 손바뀜이 일어났다는 것을 뜻한다. 단일종목 레버리지 상장지수펀드 거의 전부인 15∼16종이 3일 내내 순위권에 들었고, 다수 상품의 회전율이 100∼200%였다. 1일 기준 삼성전자와 에스케이하이닉스의 일일회전율이 각각 0.77%, 0.79%인 것과 비교하면 단타 양상이 극도로 강하다.)

Leveraged ETFs, which have double the volatility of regular stocks, are generally recommended for short-term holding of 3 to 5 trading days due to the characteristic of lower cumulative returns over extended periods (negative compounding effect). Thus, concerns about frequent turnover arose even before their launch. However, the current short-term overheating far exceeds expectations. Professor Lee Jun-seo of Dongguk University (Business Administration) said, “ETFs are products designed to form a portfolio to hedge risks, but constructing them with just two stocks that account for 50% of the market has led to a situation where the tail wags the dog. The authorities seem to have introduced them to boost the index, taking advantage of the favorable conditions, but the impact on the overall market has grown far larger than expected, necessitating a slowdown.” (변동률이 일반 종목의 2배인 레버리지 상장지수펀드는 장기 보유할수록 누적 수익률이 일반 종목보다 낮아지는 특성(음의 복리 효과)상 3∼5거래일 단기 매매를 권장하고 있다. 이 때문에 출시 이전부터 잦은 손바뀜에 대한 우려가 일었다. 다만 지금의 단기 과열은 예상을 훌쩍 뛰어넘는 수준이다. 이준서 동국대 교수(경영학)는 “상장지수펀드는 포트폴리오를 구성해 위험을 회피(헤지)하기 위한 상품인데 시장의 50%를 차지하는 두 종목으로 구성하니 꼬리가 몸통을 흔드는 격이 됐다”며 “당국이 소위 말해 ‘물 들어온 김에 노 젓는다’며 지수를 상승시키려 도입했겠지만, 예상보다 전체 시장에 미치는 영향이 너무나 커져 속도 조절이 필요한 상황”이라고 말했다.)

The frequent turnover is also driven by the high proportion of individual investors. Individual investors, who lack the information advantage of institutions, are more prone to the allure of day trading. According to investor trading performance in the ETF market on the 27th to 29th, individuals net purchased 3.3 trillion won, foreigners net purchased 300 billion won, and institutions net sold 3.7 trillion won. Professor Kim Dae-jong of Sejong University (Business Administration) noted, “Korea, as a country with a history of having the world’s highest trading volume in futures and options, has strong betting tendencies among investors. In a way, the current short-term overheating is a foreseen outcome.” (잦은 손바뀜의 배경에는 개인 투자자의 비중이 높다는 점도 있다. 기관보다 관련 정보가 부족한 개인 투자자는 단타의 유혹에 빠지기 쉽다는 것이다. 이날 상장지수펀드 시장의 투자자별 거래실적을 따져보면, 지난 27∼29일 개인이 3조3천억원을 순매수했고, 외국인은 3천억원 순매수, 기관은 3조7천억원 순매도했다. 김대종 세종대 교수(경영학)는 “과거 한국은 선물·옵션 거래대금이 세계 1위를 차지할 정도로 투자자의 베팅 성향이 강한 나라라서, 어찌 보면 지금의 단기 과열은 예견된 결과”라고 지적했다.)

Regarding the expansion of stock market volatility, financial authorities are closely watching potential harm to individual investors. A senior official at the Financial Supervisory Service said, “We are most concerned that in the event of a sharp downturn, individual investors who used retirement or living funds for investment could face significant asset losses.” The FSS plans to continuously monitor securities firms’ business practices that may encourage excessive leveraged investments, while also reviewing step-by-step response measures. The official added, “We are thoroughly preventing securities firms from conducting exaggerated advertisements or running events that induce excessive trading by investors. If volatility expands further, we will review whether additional measures can be taken.” Professor Lee said, “Additional measures, such as re-education, are needed to cool down the market’s overheating.” (이러한 증시 변동성 확대에 대해 금융당국은 개인 투자자 피해 가능성을 예의주시하고 있다. 금융감독원 고위 관계자는 “급락장이 오면 노후 대비 자금이나 생활자금으로 투자한 개인투자자들의 재산 손실이 커질 수 있다는 점을 가장 우려하고 있다”고 말했다. 금감원은 과도한 레버리지 투자 등을 부추길 수 있는 증권사 영업 행태를 지속해서 점검하는 한편 향후 단계별 대응 방안도 살펴볼 예정이다. 이 관계자는 “증권사가 과장 광고를 하거나 투자자들의 과도한 매매를 유도하는 이벤트를 하지 못하도록 철저히 차단하고 있다”며 “변동성이 더 확대될 경우 추가로 취할 수 있는 조처가 있는지 검토하겠다”고 말했다. 이 교수는 “시장의 과열을 식히기 위해 재교육 등의 추가 조처가 필요하다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Kim Ga-yoon gayoon@hani.co.kr Reporter Ahn Tae-ho eco@hani.co.kr (김가윤 기자 gayoon@hani.co.kr 안태호 기자 eco@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jensen Huang Challenges Intel and AMD, the 'CPU Titans' – 'Samgyeopsal Meeting' in Korea in Three Days (젠슨 황, ‘CPU 쌍벽’ 인텔·AMD에 도전장…사흘 뒤 한국서 ‘삼겹살 회동’)
item.description:
Cameras flashed in unison as Jensen Huang, CEO of Nvidia, pulled a semiconductor chip package smaller than the palm of his hand out of his pocket. This took place on the 1st at the Computex IT exhibition in Taipei, Taiwan, during a keynote speech. (젠슨 황 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO)가 주머니에서 손바닥보다도 작은 반도체 칩 패키지를 꺼내자 일제히 카메라 플래시가 터졌다. 1일 타이완 타이베이에서 열린 정보기술(IT) 전시회 ‘컴퓨텍스’의 기조연설 현장에서다.)

Nvidia, the U.S. company leading the global AI chip market, officially announced on that day its entry into the personal computer (PC) market for laptops and desktops. This was achieved through its self-designed 'RTX Spark Superchip'. Nvidia, which has primarily manufactured gaming graphics cards or large data center chips, is now taking direct aim at the small-scale computer market dominated by Intel and AMD. The strategy is to expand its influence across the entire AI chip market, encompassing not only big tech companies but also individual consumers. (글로벌 인공지능(AI) 칩 시장을 이끄는 미국 엔비디아는 이날 노트북·데스크톱 등 개인용 컴퓨터(PC) 시장 진출을 공식 선언했다. 자체 설계한 ‘알티엑스(RTX) 스파크 슈퍼칩’을 통해서다. 그동안 게임용 그래픽카드나 대형 데이터센터용 칩을 주로 만들던 엔비디아가 인텔·에이엠디(AMD) 등이 지배하는 소형 컴퓨터 시장을 정조준한 것이다. 빅테크(거대 기술기업)는 물론 개인 소비자까지 아우르며 인공지능 칩 시장 전반으로 지배력을 확대하겠다는 전략이다.)

The RTX Spark, unveiled by CEO Huang that day, is a chip package that integrates Nvidia's self-designed CPU 'Grace' and GPU 'Blackwell' along with 128 GB of memory in one unit. It is expected to be installed in laptops and desktops from major computer manufacturers like Dell and Lenovo starting in the second half of this year. The CPU used here was developed using chip design blueprints from Arm in the UK, in collaboration with MediaTek in Taiwan. TSMC in Taiwan will handle the production of the chip package. (이날 황 최고경영자가 공개한 알티엑스 스파크는, 엔비디아가 직접 설계한 중앙처리장치(CPU) ‘그레이스’와 그래픽처리장치(GPU) ‘블랙웰’, 그리고 128기가바이트(GB) 용량의 메모리를 한 곳에 모은 칩 패키지다. 올해 하반기부터 델, 레노버 등 주요 컴퓨터 제조사의 노트북과 데스크톱 등에 탑재될 예정이다. 여기에 들어가는 중앙처리장치는 영국 암(Arm)의 칩 설계도를 이용하고 대만 미디어텍과 협력해 개발했다. 대만 티에스엠시(TSMC)가 칩 패키지 생산을 맡는다.)

This marks Nvidia's challenge to competitors like Intel and AMD, which have dominated the laptop and desktop market for decades with CPUs based on x86 architecture. x86-based chips offer superior absolute performance, while Arm-based chips have the advantage of lower power consumption and heat generation. (이는 엔비디아가 지난 수십 년간 엑스(x)86 기반의 설계도를 반영한 중앙처리장치로 노트북·데스크톱 시장을 지배해온 미국 인텔과 에이엠디 등 경쟁사에 도전장을 내민 것이다. 엑스86 기반 칩은 절대적인 성능이, 암 기반 칩은 전력 사용 및 발열이 적다는 장점이 있다.)

At CEO Huang's keynote speech that day, Chey Tae-won, Chairman of SK Group, was also present, drawing attention. Since Nvidia's RTX Spark Superchip is equipped with high-capacity, high-performance, low-power memory, it is expected to expand demand for companies like Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. (이날 황 최고경영자의 기조연설 현장엔 최태원 에스케이(SK)그룹 회장도 자리해 눈길을 끌었다. 엔비디아의 알티엑스 스파크 슈퍼칩에 대용량의 고성능 저전력 메모리가 장착되는 만큼, 삼성전자·에스케이하이닉스 등도 수요처가 확대되는 효과가 있을 것으로 예상된다.)

After concluding his schedule in Taiwan, CEO Huang plans to visit Korea on the 4th. The next day, a 'Samgyeopsal meeting' is anticipated, with attendees including Chairman Chey Tae-won, Chairman Koo Kwang-mo of LG Group, and Chairman Lee Hae-jin of Naver. Following last year's 'Kkanbu meeting' with Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-yong and Hyundai Motor Group Chairman Chung Eui-sun, the plan is to discuss cooperation strategies through open communication with Korean companies. During his visit to Korea, CEO Huang is also expected to throw the ceremonial first pitch at a Doosan Bears home game at Jamsil Baseball Stadium in Seoul, and to hold a meeting with domestic business leaders at the Shilla Hotel. (황 최고경영자는 타이완 일정을 마친 뒤 오는 4일 한국을 찾을 예정이다. 이튿날 최태원 회장과 구광모 엘지그룹 회장, 이해진 네이버 의장 등이 참석한 ‘삼겹살 회동’ 가능성이 점쳐진다. 지난해 이재용 삼성전자 회장, 정의선 현대차그룹 회장과 함께 한 ‘깐부회동’에 이어 한국 기업들과의 격의없는 소통을 통해 협력 방안을 논의한다는 방침이다. 황 최고경영자는 방한 기간 중 서울 잠실야구장에서 열리는 두산베어스 홈경기에 시구자로 나서고, 신라호텔에서 국내 기업인들과의 간담회도 추진하는 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: What is the Hanwha Aerospace Daejeon Plant where an Explosion Occurred? (폭발 난 한화에어로 대전사업장은 어떤 곳?)
item.description:
The Hanwha Aerospace Daejeon plant, where an explosion on the 1st resulted in seven casualties, is considered a key facility of the company's defense sector. It is where large propulsion systems are developed and produced, propellant mixing and charging takes place, and tactical surface-to-surface systems are developed and manufactured, handling high-risk processes related to missile and rocket propulsion systems. The company explained that the Daejeon plant supplies over 95% of domestic propulsion system-related volumes, including rockets and missiles. (1일 폭발 사고로 7명의 사상자가 발생한 한화에어로스페이스 대전사업장은 이 회사 방산 부문 핵심 시설로 꼽힌다. 대형추진기관 개발·생산과 추진제 혼화·충전, 전술지대지 체계 개발·생산 등이 이뤄지는 곳으로, 미사일·로켓 추진체계와 관련한 고위험 공정을 다룬다. 회사 쪽은 대전사업장이 로켓과 미사일을 포함한 국내 추진체계 관련 물량의 95% 이상을 공급하고 있다고 설명했다.)

The Daejeon plant was established when Hanwha acquired the propulsion system production facility of the Agency for Defense Development (ADD) in 1987. Subsequently, as the Hanwha Group reorganized its defense business around Hanwha Aerospace, the Daejeon plant became part of the current Hanwha Aerospace defense sector. The company's domestic defense sector plants include the Daejeon plant, as well as the Changwon 2nd and 3rd plants, Yeosu plant, Boeun plant, and Hwasun factory. According to the business report, the defense sector produces howitzers, armored vehicles, launchers, ammunition and guided weapons, and navigation equipment. ( 대전사업장은 한화가 1987년 국방과학연구소(ADD)의 추진체 생산시설을 인수해 확보한 곳이다. 이후 한화그룹이 방산 사업을 한화에어로스페이스 중심으로 재편하면서 대전사업장도 현재 한화에어로스페이스 방산 부문에 속하게 됐다. 회사의 국내 방산 부문 사업장은 대전사업장을 비롯해 창원2·3사업장, 여수사업장, 보은사업장, 화순공장 등이다. 사업보고서상 방산 부문은 자주포, 장갑차, 발사대, 탄약·유도무기류 및 항법장치 등을 생산한다.)

The Daejeon plant is also a site where the company is expanding its production capacity. Previously, in July 2023, Hanwha Aerospace announced that it would invest 109.291 billion won in the plant from then until September 2028 to construct and expand production and inspection facilities and infrastructure. ( 대전사업장은 회사가 생산 능력을 키우고 있는 곳이기도 하다. 앞서 한화에어로스페이스는 2023년 7월부터 2028년 9월까지 이곳에 1092억9100만원 규모로 생산·검사설비 신설·증설 및 인프라 증설 투자를 진행 중이라고 공시한 바 있다.)

In terms of safety management, the Daejeon plant has been a site the company has highlighted as a key management target. In its '2025 Sustainability Management Report,' the company stated that starting with the Daejeon plant in 2023, it advanced risk assessments and applied the Serious Injury and Fatality (SIF) method. SIF is a technique that focuses on identifying and managing causes that could lead to serious injuries or fatalities, and the representative types suggested by the company include fires and explosions. The company explained that at the applied site, among 7,648 risk factors, it identified 2,446 SIF-related causes, reduced them to 485, and lowered the risk of serious accidents by 80%. ( 안전 관리 측면에서도 대전사업장은 회사가 중점 관리 대상으로 제시해온 사업장이다. 회사는 ‘2025 지속가능경영보고서’에서 2023년 대전사업장을 시작으로 위험성 평가 고도화와 고위험요인(SIF) 기법을 적용했다고 밝혔다. 에스아이에프는 중대 부상·사망 사고를 일으킬 수 있는 원인을 중점적으로 식별·관리하는 기법으로, 회사가 제시한 대표 유형에는 화재·폭발도 포함돼 있다. 회사는 적용 사업장에서 7648개의 위험요인 가운데 에스아이에프 관련 원인 2446개를 식별했고, 이를 485개로 줄여 중대재해 위험도를 80% 낮췄다고 설명했다.)

The Daejeon plant, which handles explosives and similar materials, also undergoes annual defense facility safety inspections under the Defense Acquisition Program Act. In its sustainability management report, the company stated that it conducted seven equipment and management improvements at the Daejeon plant in 2024. The Daejeon Metropolitan Fire Department also visited this plant, a key national defense facility, last January to inspect the maintenance and management status of major firefighting facilities and emergency response systems in case of fire. ( 화약류 등을 다루는 대전사업장은 방위사업법에 따라 해마다 방산시설 안전검사도 받는다. 회사는 지속가능경영보고서에서 2024년 대전사업장에서 7건의 설비적·관리적 개선을 수행했다고 밝혔다. 대전소방본부도 지난 1월 방위산업 분야 국가중요시설인 이 사업장을 찾아 주요 소방시설 유지·관리 상태와 화재 발생 시 비상대응체계를 점검한 바 있다.)

Reporter Yoo Ha-young yhy@hani.co.kr ( 유하영 기자 yhy@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Hanwha Chairman Kim Seung-youn: “Provide the Best Respect for Deceased Employees… Mobilize Entire Group to Address the Incident” (한화 김승연 회장 “유명 달리한 직원 최선 예우…그룹 총동원해 수습")
item.description:
Hanwha Group and Hanwha Aerospace announced on the 1st regarding the explosion accident at the Daejeon plant, “We will thoroughly investigate the cause of the accident to ensure such a tragic incident never recurs.” Chairman Kim Seung-youn of Hanwha Group stated, “I am heartbroken upon hearing that employees who were doing their best at work have died or been injured,” adding, “I offer my deepest condolences to the bereaved families along with my heartfelt sympathy.” (한화그룹과 한화에어로스페이스가 1일 대전사업장 폭발 사고와 관련해 “사고 원인을 철저히 규명해 다시는 이런 참담한 사고가 재발하지 않도록 하겠다”고 밝혔다. 김승연 한화그룹 회장은 “업무에 최선을 다하던 직원들이 숨지고 다쳤다는 소식에 애통한 심정을 가눌 길이 없다”며 “깊은 애도와 함께 유가족에게 위로의 말씀을 드린다”고 했다.)

Hanwha Group and Hanwha Aerospace released a statement that day, saying, “We are deeply saddened and regretful that five precious employees lost their lives in an accident that occurred this morning at the Hanwha Aerospace Daejeon plant,” and “We pray for the souls of the deceased and extend our sincere condolences to the bereaved families.” The statement continued, “We wish a speedy recovery for the employees injured in the accident and will spare no support in their treatment.” (한화그룹과 한화에어로스페이스는 이날 입장문을 내어 “오늘 오전 한화에어로스페이스 대전사업장에서 발생한 사고로 소중한 직원 다섯 분이 숨져 비통하고 안타깝다”며 “숨진 직원들의 명복을 빌며 유가족께 진심으로 위로의 말씀을 드린다”고 했다. 이어 “사고로 부상을 입은 직원들의 빠른 쾌유를 빌며, 치료에 모든 지원을 아끼지 않겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

The company said Chairman Kim Seung-youn urged, “Provide the utmost respect for the deceased employees and promptly and diligently carry out damage recovery, including support for bereaved families and treatment of the injured.” Chairman Kim also directed the mobilization of the entire group’s capabilities to address the incident and ordered the formation of a special response task force (TF, led by Vice Chairman Yeo Seung-joo) at the group level. (김승연 회장은 “유명을 달리한 직원들에게 최선의 예우를 하고 유가족 지원과 부상자 치료 등 피해 수습을 정성을 다해 신속하게 실행하라”고 당부했다고 회사 쪽은 밝혔다. 김 회장은 또한 사고 수습에 전 그룹의 역량을 총동원하도록 했으며, 그룹 차원의 특별대응티에프(TF·팀장 여승주 부회장)를 꾸리도록 했다.)

Hanwha Group stated, “We will thoroughly investigate the cause of the accident to ensure such a tragic incident never recurs,” and added, “We once again bow our heads and offer a deep apology to the public.” (한화그룹은 “사고 원인을 철저히 규명해 다시는 이런 참담한 사고가 재발하지 않도록 하겠다”며 “다시 한 번 국민 여러분께 고개 숙여 깊이 사과드린다”고 했다.)

At around 10:59 a.m. on this day, an explosion occurred at the Hanwha Aerospace Daejeon plant in Oesam-dong, Yuseong-gu, Daejeon. The affected Daejeon plant is where Hanwha Aerospace develops and produces propulsion systems and conducts propellant mixing and charging. (이날 오전 10시59분께 대전 유성구 외삼동 한화에어로스페이스 대전사업장에서 폭발 사고가 발생했다. 사고가 난 대전사업장은 한화에어로스페이스의 추진기관 개발·생산과 추진제 혼화·충전 등이 이뤄지는 곳이다.)

item.title: Unmanned Autonomous Excavator Operating 24/7… The Arrival of 'Legal' Infinite Work Machines (24시간 쉬지 않는 무인 자율 굴착기…‘합법’ 무한 노동기계의 등장)
item.description:
On the 29th of last month (local time), at an old quarry site in Tuggen, Switzerland. A 22-ton mid-sized excavator (Develon DX225LC) from HD Hyundai Construction Equipment was digging a ditch at the foot of a mountain. It was a spot meant to be filled with rocks to prevent landslides. There was no operator in the cab. No one using remote control was visible nearby. When given the task of digging a ditch measuring 300 meters long, 6 meters wide, and 3 meters deep, cameras and LiDAR mounted on the cab roof began a 360-degree 3D scan of the surrounding terrain. It selected the optimal path to move, identified differences between the blueprint and actual terrain to determine where and how much to dig, and scooped out the soil. The on-site manager from the local construction company KIBAG expressed satisfaction with the speed and quality of the work. A German civil engineering and construction media outlet reported, "Amid the worsening shortage of skilled workers, autonomous equipment that improves the efficiency of earthmoving and loading tasks is an attractive investment target." HD Hyundai Construction Equipment stated, "Since it is free from the inevitable increase in fatigue and decline in concentration that human workers experience, it can achieve 120% productivity compared to manned operation." <<> The ability to perform unmanned autonomous excavation is due to the AI-based unmanned automation solution 'X-Work' (Real-X). It surveys the work terrain to position itself and precisely controls the angles and force of the boom, arm, and bucket—which serve as the excavator's arm and hand—to excavate along the optimal path. Jang Gye-bong, a senior researcher at the AI Convergence Center of HD Hyundai Site Solution, who participated in the development of X-Work, observed the demonstration work at the Swiss site. Senior Researcher Jang told *The Hankyoreh*, "Excavators are construction machines that perform various tasks. For drainage work, they not only dig the ground but also move pipes. If they encounter rocks, they must break them. We are developing these autonomous tasks one by one. Currently, we are focusing on developing digging technology and dumping technology for loading onto trucks or moving to specific locations." <<> At the CES event in the United States in January this year, where the humanoid robot Atlas amazed the world, construction equipment integrated with artificial intelligence also garnered significant attention. It is said that over 700 autonomous trucks made by the U.S. construction equipment company Caterpillar are operating nonstop in quarries and mines worldwide. In some U.S. work sites, 100-ton autonomous trucks work 24 hours a day without shift changes. Extreme cold and heat are not issues. The company has also unveiled autonomous excavators, bulldozers, and loaders, but has not yet achieved the commercialization of complex unmanned autonomous functions like excavation. <<> An offline training ground filled with dust and a virtual training center equipped with large monitors serve as the 'intern' X-Work's training institute. The core is to datafy and teach the excavation know-how of skilled workers. State sensors that measure the excavator's posture and position are installed on the drive units, including the boom, arm, bucket, and swing mechanism. Control signals generated when a human operator moves the left and right joysticks in the cab to extend, retract, and rotate the machine's arm and shovel are extracted. At the same time, status information such as motor load and cylinder pressure is collected in real time. Senior Researcher Jang said, "The moments when an operator in the cab visually perceives the surrounding terrain, judges the appropriate work, and controls the excavator with the joystick to perform the task are collected along the work timeline as video data and action data. Through repeated learning, the excavator internalizes a pipeline where it can ask questions and find answers on its own when faced with similar situations." For example, if an unmanned autonomous excavator recognizes a rock ahead through its camera, it analyzes the optimal behavior, such as avoiding or digging it out, based on previously collected actions of human operators, and then executes the work accordingly. This is akin to a new employee learning by watching, asking, and listening to explanations from a veteran senior colleague. However, the unmanned autonomous excavator, which has learned rich work experience and improvisational skills entirely from humans, will in the future develop and replicate its own labor and pass it on to other excavators. <<> The civil engineering and construction industry has low profit margins. There is significant pressure to shorten construction periods. The reliance on physical labor from skilled workers is high. In Korea and abroad, the decline in new young workers is accelerating the aging of the skilled workforce. According to data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, the average tenure of construction workers is 4.1 years (as of 2024). Last year, the National Center for Construction Education and Research (NCCER) in the U.S. predicted that 94% of construction companies are facing labor shortages, and 41% of the construction workforce will retire by 2031. If generational transition is delayed, skills and experience are not passed down and evaporate as a project ends. The small construction equipment company Doosan Bobcat unveiled 'Bobcat Jobsite Companion' at this year's CES, a technology that allows even novice workers to control over 50 equipment functions using voice commands via an AI-based large language model (LLM). When a worker states the desired task, it automatically optimizes equipment settings, engine RPM, etc. Doosan Bobcat stated, "It lowers the entry barrier for novice workers and supports skilled experts to work faster and more accurately." The AI transformation of construction sites, a key job-creating industry, is an irreversible trend. <<> How to Move People <<> A report from the Korea Labor Institute, titled 'AI-Based Manufacturing Innovation and Employment' published in January this year, surveyed the reduction rate of work hours by skilled job groups when using robots. The architecture and construction job group, which involves physical work, showed a relatively high reduction rate of 35-45%. When AI is combined with robots, this figure increases further. <<> New construction machinery and equipment combining AI, robots, and data are increasingly appearing at construction sites. New job roles for handling them are also emerging. Correspondingly, the areas not covered by existing construction technology and skill certifications are expanding. Unmanned and autonomous technologies are advancing rapidly at a dizzying pace, and skilled workers and engineers on-site are increasingly being relegated to a role of intermediate assistants. <<> In a research report titled 'Construction Industry Transformed by the AI Era,' published last month and exceeding 700 pages, the Construction & Economy Research Institute of Korea (CERIK) pointed out this issue, stating, "Skilled workers will choose to leave the site and retire early." The role of skilled workers on construction sites is not disappearing. The report noted, "Precisely managing robot work, finalizing work quality, and responding to unexpected site variables remain human domains." It argues that the role of skilled workers shifts from performing tasks directly to management, judgment, and responsibility. Even so, since overall employment reduction is inevitable, a social consensus process is needed on the pace and level of this transition. Kim Young-deok, a senior research fellow at CERIK's Future Industry Policy Research Lab who participated in writing the report, said, "Under the premise that existing work areas, labor methods, and working hours remain unchanged, we can talk about job losses due to AI. However, there are fundamental problems facing our economy and industry, such as population decline, aging, and productivity drops. In this situation, the use of AI will serve to supplement the workforce and productivity. But since it is clear that the scope of simple labor will shrink, how to transition these workers through retraining and other means is crucial." <<> Due to the nature of the construction industry, there are many barriers to retraining. Construction workers, for whom projects take priority, find it difficult to receive training according to a set schedule. With a daily wage-based pay structure, participating in training can lead to income loss. For small and medium-sized companies, shallow talent pools make it hard to cover absences caused by training. Education programs are also often employment-linked, making them incompatible with the life cycle of already-employed workers. The report calls for addressing the "lack of a national design for how to move people" and proposes measures such as "income-compensating training that provides allowances proportional to training hours" and "policies to support the cost of substitute workers for small and medium-sized construction companies." <<> Reporter Kim Nam-il namfic@hani.co.kr (지난달 29일(현지시각) 스위스 투겐의 옛 채석장 자리. 에이치디(HD)건설기계의 22t 중형 굴착기(디벨론 DX225LC)가 산기슭에 도랑을 냈다. 산사태 방지를 위해 암석을 채울 자리였다. 운전석에는 작업자가 없었다. 주변에서 원격 제어하는 사람도 보이지 않았다. 길이 300m, 폭 6m, 깊이 3m 크기 도랑을 파라는 임무를 부여하자, 운전석 지붕에 장착된 카메라와 라이다가 주변 지형을 360도 3디(D) 스캔을 시작했다. 최적의 경로를 선택해 움직이고, 도면과 실제 지형 차이를 파악해 어디를 얼마나 파낼지 결정하고, 흙을 퍼냈다. 현지 건설기업 키바그(KIBAG) 소속 현장소장은 작업 속도와 완성도에 만족감을 나타냈다. 독일 토목·건설 전문매체는 “숙련 노동자 부족 문제가 심화하는 상황에서 토공 및 상차 작업 효율을 높이는 자율주행 장비는 매력적 투자 대상”이라고 전했다. 에이치디건설기계는 “인간 작업자라면 겪을 수밖에 없는 피로도 증가와 집중력 저하에서 자유롭기 때문에 유인 운전 대비 120%의 생산성을 올릴 수 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: The 'Tacit Knowledge AI' Extracting the Five Senses of Manufacturing Masters: Whose Labor Is This? (제조 명장의 오감을 추출하는 ‘암묵지 AI’…이 노동은 누구의 것인가)
item.description:
"I used to rely on my five senses to judge over 70 subtle signs, such as the pitch of molten steel splashing in the converter, the angle at which the flames spread, and the faint heat inside the workspace." <<> Lee Young-jin (58), a converter operator, is one of 29 masters selected by POSCO to pass on the future of steelmaking technology to the next generation. Converter operation is a core task in the steelmaking process, where oxygen is blown into molten steel freshly tapped from the blast furnace to remove impurities and alter its properties for specific uses. It requires accurately reading temperatures reaching 1,600–1,700°C just by the color of the flame and determining the amount and duration of oxygen blowing based on the steel's color, sound, temperature, and flame shape. Lee told *The Hankyoreh*, "Skills can be taught through manuals, but the intuition to grasp the state of molten steel requires a long period of accumulation. Sometimes, juniors find the extended learning and accumulation process challenging. I believe it's more important than ever to foster a spirit of craftsmanship beyond technique—making juniors observe the site as if conversing with the molten steel over the long term." <<> POSCO has been steadily working on 'smart factory' initiatives since the 2010s, combining the experience, intuition, knowledge, and skills of technicians who know the field best. A POSCO official explained, "We have been datafying key variables that determine the converter's state and conducting deep learning to simulate the work know-how of veterans with over 30 years of experience, extracting optimal results." Now, the master's five senses have been smartened into 'one-touch converter operation,' where the worker simply presses a button to perform the optimal process. Quality deviations between workers are said to have disappeared. <<> South Korea is a manufacturing powerhouse. Its manufacturing sector's share of GDP is the second highest among OECD member countries. By securing a position in the global core supply chain, the country has strengthened its resilience against the US-China trade war and repeated geopolitical crises. On manufacturing floors, there are artisans and masters, like POSCO's masters, who produce world-class products through physical sensations ingrained over decades—'tacit knowledge.' While artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly coexisting in offices and production sites or replacing human labor, the invisible and inaudible tacit knowledge of manufacturing remains a human domain. <<> The retirement of skilled workers from the second baby boomer generation (born 1964–1974), who support South Korea's manufacturing competitiveness, is accelerating. Large corporations have viewed tacit knowledge—not conveyed through words or manuals—as a core corporate asset and have contemplated preservation and transfer methods. However, many small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) cannot guarantee survival even one to two years after their key personnel retire. This is the backdrop for the government designating manufacturing tacit knowledge, acquired through physical experience, as a 'national core asset' and moving to secure it. The Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy stated, "Manufacturing tacit knowledge—such as the work techniques, judgment standards, and sensory know-how of artisans and skilled workers that are not quantified—is not easily transferable, so it risks being lost and severed upon retirement." In April, it launched a project to develop an AI model based on manufacturing tacit knowledge. The ambitious plan aims to secure 'unstructured data' containing the tacit knowledge of manufacturing masters in key sectors: △automotive △shipbuilding △steel △machinery △electronics (including semiconductors and displays) △bio/chemical △defense △root industries (casting, molds, welding, surface treatment, etc.) △textiles. SMEs facing the risk of tacit knowledge loss are the primary targets. The ministry presented the project goal as "accelerating AI transformation (AX) in manufacturing by utilizing manufacturing tacit knowledge infused with the experience, intuition, and judgment of manufacturing masters." About 30 tasks are to be selected, with 1.6 billion won allocated per task. <<> The process of turning subtle intuitive judgments and delicate fingertip labor into digital data is not easy. The Korea Planning & Evaluation Institute of Industrial Technology (KEIT) is overseeing the screening and evaluation of the manufacturing tacit knowledge acquisition project. The key is how to secure and train AI on unstructured data—such as movements, sounds, vibrations, and judgments—that are difficult to quantify. The tacit knowledge of masters conceals the context of data that is hard to explain in words. Video, audio, images, and other diverse data (multimodal data) with correlations must be extracted and refined in time series. Jin Jong-cheol, head of KEIT's Manufacturing AX Diffusion Policy Office, explained, "There are data formats suitable for the tacit knowledge of each industry." For instance, in the root industries, casting or surface treatment heavily involves fingertip sensations—intuition linked to weather, humidity, etc. Some engineers identify issues on a car production line through vibrations and sounds. At a coastal shipyard, humidity spikes after rain, causing internal bubbles and defective welding. Experienced workers reportedly compensate by using more solder than usual. Jin said, "There are related data like the day's weather, temperature, humidity, sounds, and the physical properties of the welding rod. Additionally, the process and results of how the master worked differently than usual can be quantified into a form AI can learn from. Based on the AI model's 'judgment' learned from the master's tacit knowledge, we compare and verify how similar results an unskilled worker produces when performing the same task." <<> The government emphasizes that securing manufacturing tacit knowledge is about 'securing core technology at risk of disappearing,' not 'replacing human labor.' While labor groups share the direction, they express concerns about the methods. At a May 12 meeting hosted by the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy to gather opinions from labor and management on manufacturing tacit knowledge, the Korean Confederation of Trade Unions (KCTU) stated, "We face manufacturing crises from global supply chain restructuring and competitors' AI adoption. We sympathize with the government's policy direction to use AI in manufacturing innovation," but pointed out that it is being pursued unilaterally without societal discussions on structural changes like job reductions. In particular, they called for measures to address: △monopolization of profits by companies collecting and using tacit knowledge data △potential exposure of personal information and privacy during the extraction process △the possibility of performance evaluations (including reassignment or dismissal) based on AI-optimized work models. <<> Park (surname withheld), CEO of a solution development company who attended the Yeongnam region briefing on the manufacturing tacit knowledge project held in Changwon, South Gyeongsang Province, in April, told *The Hankyoreh*, "The project's intent is good, but social commitments or directions regarding the disclosure of lifelong manufacturing know-how should have been discussed first." He added, "The project seems more focused on securing tacit knowledge data first rather than developing a tacit knowledge AI model." Similar criticisms arose at a Seoul metropolitan area briefing. One attendee said, "Tacit knowledge data is confidential, containing company know-how, so sharing it is burdensome." Seo Wan-seok, chairman of the Korea Masters Association, who attended the briefing, told *The Hankyoreh*, "Industrial masters affiliated with companies may find it difficult to participate due to security issues. Even if they participate, it's unclear what scope and level of the vast tacit knowledge accumulated over decades will be quantitatively collected." A KEIT official responded, "We cannot perfectly replace a master's level. The aim is to avoid a form monopolized by a specific company and manage it as a national data asset. The use of tacit knowledge data will be decided through consultation with providers and others." <<> The 'Labor-Management Coexistence Committee for AI Transformation,' launched in March under the presidential Economic, Social and Labor Council, will discuss issues such as alleviating employment anxiety from AI adoption, creating new jobs, and sharing excess profits. The KCTU stated, "Workers' skills and experience are not mere data but the result of labor accumulated over a long time. The project should be pursued in a direction where industrial competitiveness and labor rights protection go hand in hand." <<> Reporter Kim Nam-il namfic@hani.co.kr (“전로에서 쇳물이 튀는 소리의 높낮이, 불꽃이 퍼지는 각도, 작업장 내부의 미세한 열기 등 70여 가지 미묘한 징후를 오감에 의존해 판단했었죠.”)

item.title: May Consumer Prices Rise 3.1%... Highest in 2 Years and 2 Months (5월 소비자물가 3.1% 상승…2년 2개월만에 최고치)
item.description:
May consumer prices rose 3.1% from a year earlier, marking the highest increase in 2 years and 2 months. Due to the surge in international oil prices amid the aftermath of the US-Israel and Iran wars, petroleum products jumped by 24%, pushing up overall prices by more than 0.9 percentage points. (5월 소비자물가가 1년 전보다 3.1% 올라 2년2개월만에 가장 높은 상승률을 기록했다. 미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁 여파에 따른 국제유가 상승으로 석유류가 24% 오르면서 전체 물가를 0.9%포인트 넘게 끌어올렸다.)

According to the May consumer price trends released by the National Data Office on the 2nd, last month's consumer prices increased by 3.1% compared to a year ago. This is the largest rise since March 2024 (3.1%). The consumer price inflation rate, which dropped from 2.3% in December last year to 2.0% in January-February, rose to 2.2% in March and 2.6% in April, before jumping 0.5 percentage points in just one month. (국가데이터처가 2일 발표한 5월 소비자물가동향을 보면, 지난달 소비자물가는 1년 전보다 3.1% 상승한 것으로 나타났다. 2024년 3월(3.1%) 이후 최대 상승폭이다. 소비자물가 상승률은 지난해 12월 2.3%에서 지난 1~2월 2.0%로 하락했으나 3월 2.2%, 4월 2.6%로 오르더니 한 달 만에 0.5%포인트 뛰었다.)

By item, petroleum product prices soared by 24.2% year-on-year, driving up overall prices by 0.92 percentage points. This is the highest since July 2022 (33.5%) during the Russia-Ukraine war, a gap of 3 years and 10 months. Diesel (33.3%) and gasoline (23.1%) rose significantly. International airfare (33.5%) and overseas package tour costs (26.3%), influenced by oil prices, also saw large increases. Notably, international airfare recorded the highest increase since the survey began in 1995. Engine oil replacement fees (14%), laundry fees (11.3%), which are affected by the prices of naphtha and other petrochemical products, and home repair materials (5.0%), reflecting paint prices, also saw larger increases than the previous month. (품목별로는 석유류의 상승률이 전년 대비 24.2% 뛰어오르면서 전체 물가를 0.92%포인트 끌어올렸다. 러시아-우크라이나 전쟁이 있었던 2022년 7월(33.5%) 이후 3년10개월 만이다. 경유(33.3%)와 휘발유(23.1%)가 큰 폭으로 상승했다. 유가 영향을 받는 국제항공료(33.5%)와 해외단체여행비(26.3%)도 크게 올랐다. 특히 국제항공료는 조사를 시작한 1995년 이후 가장 높은 상승 폭이다. 나프타 등 석유화학제품 가격 영향을 받는 엔진오일 교체료(14%), 세탁료(11.3%), 페인트 가격이 반영되는 주택수선재료(5.0%)도 각각 전달보다 상승 폭을 키웠다.)

The oil price increases have not yet spread to processed foods (0.8%) and agricultural, livestock, and fishery products (2.2%). Lee Doo-won, Economic Trends Statistics Director at the Data Office, said, "Processed foods continue their trend of narrowing increases, and the rise in agricultural, livestock, and fishery products is also limited," adding, "The impact of the Middle East war has not yet expanded to other sectors, but we need to monitor it further." (유가 상승이 가공식품(0.8%)과 농축수산물(2.2%) 등으로 확대되진 않았다. 이두원 데이터처 경제동향통계심의관은 “가공식품은 상승 폭 축소 추세가 이어지고 있고 농축수산물 상승 폭도 제한적”이라며 “아직 다른 분야까지 중동 전쟁 영향이 확대되지 않았지만 좀더 지켜볼 필요가 있다”고 말했다.)

The Living Price Index, which consists mainly of frequently purchased items and closely matches perceived inflation, rose by 3.3%. This is the largest increase in 2 years and 1 month since April 2024 (3.6%). The core inflation indicator, excluding food and energy based on the OECD methodology, increased by 2.5%. (자주 구매하는 품목 위주로 구성돼 체감물가에 가까운 생활물가지수는 3.3% 상승했다. 2024년 4월(3.6%) 이후 2년1개월 만에 가장 큰 상승 폭이다. 경제협력개발기구(OECD) 방식의 근원물가 지표인 식료품 및 에너지 제외 지수는 2.5% 올랐다.)

Reporter Park Soo-ji suji@hani.co.kr (박수지 기자 suji@hani.co.kr)
